intro: Nori's Mug is the personal drinking vessel of Nori Pridedrift, used to deliver scalding mornbrew across the frigid drifts of Dun Morogh. After delivering a warm drink to stave off the biting alpine chill, travelers are tasked with returning the empty cup to its thrifty owner.

p: In the freezing mountain passes of Dun Morogh, a piping hot tankard of mornbrew is one of the few comforts capable of cutting through the bitter cold. Nori Pridedrift entrusts his mug to travelers delivering a fresh, steaming pour to Durnan Furcutter in Anvilmar. Once drained, the sturdy vessel must make the trek back. As Nori notes, mugs do not grow on trees, and keeping track of hard-wearing dwarven dishware is essential business when hospitality meets snowy wilderness.
